name: Ekta Mall Food Court
area: Statue of Unity complex, Ekta Nagar (Kevadia)
why_it_matters: Inside the Statue of Unity complex at Ekta Nagar — opened 2018 alongside the statue inauguration. Multiple food counters under one roof (North Indian, South Indian, Chinese, Gujarati, fast food). Khodiyar Kathiyawadi counter handles the Gujarati thali. Designed for the 8,000+ daily visitor flow. Food is not allowed in from outside the complex.
insider_tip: Eat here only if you're inside the SOU complex — outside the gate, Tent City and Garudeshwar have better options. Khodiyar Kathiyawadi counter is the best counter; soft-serve is overpriced. Carry water; bottled water inside is ₹40 for the small.
signature_address: Inside Statue of Unity complex, Ekta Mall, Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Narmada District, Gujarat 393151

name: Tent City 1 Dining Hall
why_it_matters: Tent City 1 is the GTDC-operated tented accommodation at Sardar Sarovar Dyke-4, ~3km from the Statue. Dining hall serves buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner included in stay tariff; day-visitors can pre-book meals. Gujarati spread with rotating regional dishes; the only sit-down dining on the Dyke side. Open year-round (unlike Rann tent cities, which are seasonal).
insider_tip: Day-visit meals must be pre-booked at the SOU online portal — walk-in lunch is not available. Breakfast (7-9am) is the strongest buffet slot; live dosa station opens early. Dinner is curated by visiting Gujarati guest-chefs on Saturdays during peak season (Oct-Mar) — worth timing the trip to.
signature_address: Tent City 1, Dyke-4, Sardar Sarovar Dam, Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Narmada District, Gujarat 393151

name: Tent City Narmada (Tent City 2)
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine buffet with Darbari Tent banquet
why_it_matters: Operated by Praveg, Tent City 2 (branded as Tent City Narmada) is the privately-run sister property at Dyke-3, ~3km from the Statue. Pure-veg restaurant, multi-cuisine, included with stay packages. Darbari tent block hosts the upscale dining experience. Better service-to-tariff ratio than Tent City 1 per most reviewer comparisons.
insider_tip: Stay packages include all meals — that's the right way to eat here. Day-visit meals are bookable but at a premium. The Darbari block is the upgrade if you want quieter dining; standard tents share a communal dining hall.
signature_address: Tent City Narmada, Dyke-3, Sardar Sarovar Dam, Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Narmada District, Gujarat 393151

name: Zarvani Restaurant at The Fern Sardar Sarovar
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine fine dining with Vindhya hill views
why_it_matters: The Fern Hotels (eco-luxury chain) resort at Sardar Sarovar opened 2019 — Zarvani is its all-day multi-cuisine restaurant, the closest fine-dining to SOU outside the tent cities. Hill-view dining hall, kitchen handles veg + non-veg (rare in this pure-veg zone). Wins for travellers staying at Fern and for day-visitors who want a non-tent-city meal.
insider_tip: Reservation matters on weekends — Fern is the wedding venue for Ekta Nagar; restaurant gets booked out for functions. The non-veg side is the kitchen's stronger half. Outdoor terrace seating in winter (Oct-Feb) is the best seat in the house.
signature_address: The Fern Sardar Sarovar, Vishrampur, Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Narmada District, Gujarat 393151

name: Aaha Food Cafe
signature_dish: Cafe-format light meals near SOU entry
why_it_matters: Café-format outlet at the Statue of Unity visitor centre entry plaza — picks up the post-statue / pre-bus-out walking traffic. Fast-food and sandwich format, not a full meal experience. Pure-veg, hygienic, transparent pricing (SOU complex is regulated).
insider_tip: Best as a quick stop, not a destination — full meals are at Ekta Mall Food Court or Tent City. Coffee here is instant, not brewed; manage expectations. Cleaner washrooms than the typical site canteen — useful if you've come on the long-distance bus.
signature_address: Visitor Centre / Entry Plaza, Statue of Unity, Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Narmada District, Gujarat 393151
